description: This is a Java interface defining the MerchantConfigurationService, which provides methods for managing merchant configuration data such as retrieval, saving, and listing configurations based on store and type.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationService
classes.description: A service interface for managing merchant configuration data, including retrieval, creation, update, and listing of configurations based on store and type.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific merchant configuration based on a key and store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new merchant configuration or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all merchant configurations associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by configuration type and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Retrieves merchant configuration settings for a specific store.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Saves merchant configuration settings for a specific store.
